data.body:
[P2] Establish evidence for the empty-error service contract

Rule 6, “Mark unverified assumptions,” requires evidence for external behavior or an explicit unverified assumption. This calls the empty `Payload` shape actual AWS behavior and makes it a conformance requirement, but the description supplies neither evidence for that exact response nor an unverified designation. Local-runner assertions cannot establish the service contract they themselves prescribe. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and document the supporting service response or specification, or identify the assumption as unverified for a maintainer decision.
